faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up your digital loyalty program.

items.question: What is the founding partner program?
items.answer: As a founding partner, you get early access to Stampeo with all Growth features. You'll help shape the product with direct feedback. After {freeMonths} free months, you lock in €{growthFoundingPrice}/month for life (normally €{growthPrice}).

items.question: How do I create my loyalty card?
items.answer: Your card is created automatically during setup. Just upload your logo and pick your colors — you'll see a preview instantly. Customize anything you like, then publish when you're happy with it.

items.question: Do my customers need to download an app?
items.answer: No, Stampeo works directly through the web browser or can be added to digital wallets like Apple Wallet or Google Pay. Zero friction for your customers.

items.question: What equipment do I need?
items.answer: Any device with an internet connection. You can scan from our free app or directly from your browser — your choice.

items.question: How do customers get stamped?
items.answer: Your customers show their digital card (in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet) and you scan it with the Stampeo app or from your browser. Only you add stamps — not the customer — which prevents any fraud.

items.question: How does early access work?
items.answer: After signing up, we get in touch directly to get to know you and set up your program together. We handle your card configuration, scanner app setup, and stay available to support you along the way.

items.question: Does it work with Google Wallet?
items.answer: Yes. Stampeo generates cards compatible with both Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. The vast majority of smartphones (iPhone and Android) are covered. Features are identical on both platforms, except for location-based notifications which are currently only available on Apple Wallet.

items.question: Can a business have multiple loyalty cards?
items.answer: Each business runs one active loyalty program at a time. On Growth and Pro you can save several card styles and switch which one is live, but your customers always collect stamps on a single card. That keeps rewards simple for you and for them.

items.question: Can I send promotional campaigns?
items.answer: Yes — promotional broadcasts are live. The Growth plan includes 8 broadcasts per month with immediate send and date-based segmentation (e.g. customers enrolled in the last 30 days). The Pro plan unlocks unlimited broadcasts, scheduling with timezone support, and advanced segmentation (by stamp count, redemptions, or inactivity). Automatic notifications (stamp, milestone, reward) remain active on all plans.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The Starter plan is €{starterPrice}/month (founding rate: €{starterFoundingPrice}/month for life). No setup fee, no commitment. You start with 1 month free. We ask for your card to begin the trial, with no charge before the month is up.

items.question: Do I need to change my till?
items.answer: No. Stampeo works with any till, or with no till at all. You scan from our free app or straight from a browser. Zero integration required.

items.question: Do my customers have to download anything?
items.answer: No. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet are already installed on every recent smartphone. Your customers scan your QR code and their card is added in one move. That's it.

items.question: What happens after the first month?
items.answer: You choose whether to continue. We ask for your card to start the trial, but nothing is charged before the 30 days are up. If you continue as a founding partner, you lock in your rate for life.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Stampeo is GDPR compliant, our servers are in Europe, and we never resell your customer data. It's yours, and you export it whenever you want.

items.question: How many customers can I enroll?
items.answer: The Starter, Growth and Pro plans differ by features (notifications, broadcasts, advanced analytics), not by volume. See the pricing page for the details of each plan.

items.question: Can I change my card later?
items.answer: Yes. You can change the logo, colors, number of stamps and rewards at any time from your dashboard. Cards already installed on your customers' phones update automatically, with nothing to re-download.
